# Unicode-mode set tests for regexped.
# Run with: go run . --sets -unicode custom-sets-unicode.txt
#
# Every block runs in Unicode mode. Expectations are computed LIVE from Go by
# the set runner, which counts Go's tokens, so no match may start, and no
# empty match may be reported, inside a character. col1 and col4 are Go's
# FindStringIndex / FindAllStringIndex, REGENERATED by
#
#     go run ./make_sets custom-sets-unicode.txt
#
# Rows over invalid UTF-8 beside a member that can match U+FFFD are skipped by
# the runner (Go and Unicode mode differ there by design), which is why the
# invalid-input block carries no such member.
#
# Format: col0=unused; col1=first find; col2="-"; col3="-"; col4=all finds.
# ============================================================
# Empty matches with no assertion: none inside a character.
# ============================================================
UniEmptyAnywhere
